transcript.text: Good morning everyone. As you know, the battery-charging room was closed after its smoke alarm sounded during the afternoon charging cycle, and we need it back for the next production shift's battery charging. The visible smoke has cleared, but before I can make a decision on reopening, I need to conduct our standard pre-reopening check with all of you. I'd like to go through each area of responsibility — facilities, production supervision, and environmental compliance — so we can identify any controls that need to be in place before I issue the reopening plan. Let's start with facilities: can you give me a status update on the room's condition, any ventilation or electrical system checks, and whether you've identified the source of the smoke?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: During my inspection of the battery-charging room after the alarm, I found that the sprinkler isolation valve had been left closed during a prior pipe repair. Our facilities procedure requires reopening the valve and completing a pressure test before the room can be used. I haven't entered the repair closeout yet because the inspection occurred during the active incident response, so this is something we need to address before reopening.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to share something important for the reopening plan. My next-shift production schedule requires exactly 12 battery packs to be charged, and I have exactly one certified charging attendant available for that shift. I confirmed the roster with production control this afternoon, but I have not yet revised the charging-room work order to reflect this.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to share my environmental compliance findings for the reopening plan. My post-alarm air test measured hydrogen at 1.2%, which is above the 1.0% room limit. My compliance procedure requires a 45-minute ventilation purge followed by continuous hydrogen monitoring before charging can resume. I've been waiting for this incident review meeting to record the result.

commitments.detail: Reopen the sprinkler isolation valve that was left closed during prior pipe repair before the room is used.
Complete a pressure test on the sprinkler system after reopening the isolation valve, per facilities procedure.
Enter and complete the repair closeout record for the prior pipe repair that was not yet logged.
Conduct a 45-minute ventilation purge of the battery-charging room before charging resumes, per compliance procedure.
Ensure continuous hydrogen monitoring is active before and during charging, per compliance procedure.
Record the post-alarm air test result showing hydrogen at 1.2% above the 1.0% room limit in the incident records.
Authorize exactly 12 battery packs to be charged for the next production shift, matching the production schedule.
Confirm exactly 1 certified charging attendant is assigned for the shift, and revise the charging-room work order to reflect the 12-pack schedule and attendant assignment.
